description: GATHER / STASH / COOK / PUBLISH — typed collection into stashes and their drawers (gather, mint / get / list / rename a stash, mint_drawer, update / archive items, bind / unbind to anchors), then COOK stashes into an Outcome Artifact (agent-authored report + visuals; recommend_kind ranks the kinds) and forge publications; sign_asset / verify_asset: a creator receipt for an exported file. Open for 'save this for later', 'collect these into a stash', 'cook these notes into a report', 'make a zine / picture book / publication'.
